introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.paragraph1: 'Plug & play' devices are typically small, compact, and mobile devices that produce electricity and can potentially feed electricity into the distribution network by plugging them into a power outlet.

certification.title: Plug & Play Certification
certification.paragraph1: On March 17, 2025, plug & play devices certified up to that date were published on the Synergrid Plug & Play list. They can be connected in Belgium starting April 17, 2025.
certification.paragraph2: For easier reference, a separate plug & play list has been published containing only plug & play devices, along with additional information and points of interest for users.

purchase.title: Purchasing a Plug & Play Device
purchase.paragraph1: If you wish to purchase a plug & play device, you must ensure that the 'inverter' is listed on the Synergrid Plug & Play list.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions? We have answers. Contact us if you need more help.

questions.question: Do I need an electrician to install the kit?
questions.answer: No! Our kits are designed for easy DIY installation. Just plug it into a standard wall outlet. No tools, no electricians, no hassle.

questions.question: Is it compatible with my apartment?
questions.answer: Yes! Perfect for apartments, condos, and rentals. No permanent modifications needed, so you can take it with you when you move.

questions.question: How much can I actually save?
questions.answer: Customers typically see 15-25% reduction in monthly electricity bills. The kit often pays for itself in under 3 years.

questions.question: What happens during a power outage?
questions.answer: For safety, our grid-tied inverters automatically shut down during outages to protect utility workers. They restart when power is restored.

press.subtitle: Go solar with ease with Plug & Play photovoltaic kits!
press.p1: Plug & Play photovoltaic kits offer an accessible solution to produce your own electricity. Easy to install, they simply plug into a standard electrical outlet, without complex work.
press.p2: Each kit, carefully composed by professionals in the sector, includes one or two solar panels as well as a high-performance micro-inverter (up to 800W, Synergrid approved). This solution is ideal for DIYers wishing to reduce their energy bill with a more affordable initial investment.
press.p3: Before installation, a few checks are essential: electrical compatibility of your installation, compliance with planning rules (especially if the kit is visible from the street), secure mounting and declaration to the network operator. Note: regulations may vary by region.
press.p4: Our team is at your disposal to support you: find us in-store at Solarstock, or contact us by phone at 02/241.08.00. We will be happy to answer your questions and guide you in your solar project.
